summary: All 4 performance degradation incident scenarios simulated and successfully mitigated.

scenarios.name: API Ingress Latency Spike
scenarios.fault_injected: Injected synthetic +500ms network delay on POST /api/v1/documents/upload
scenarios.expected_behavior: Trigger P95 alert, activate adaptive rate limiter, maintain 200 OK responses
scenarios.observed_behavior: Alert fired in 3.8s; adaptive rate limiter throttled burst; zero 5xx errors

scenarios.name: Sudden Queue Ingestion Burst
scenarios.fault_injected: Injected 10,000 pending tasks into Redis queue in 15 seconds
scenarios.expected_behavior: Trigger Queue Depth alert, scale workers from 5 to 20, drain queue gracefully
scenarios.observed_behavior: Alert fired in 4.2s; worker auto-scaler scaled to 20 pods; queue drained in 2.1m

scenarios.name: AI Provider Latency Degradation
scenarios.fault_injected: Simulated Gemini API latency increase from 1.2s to 6.5s
scenarios.expected_behavior: Detect degradation, trip circuit breaker, route to cached local extraction fallback
scenarios.observed_behavior: Degradation detected; fallback activated in 2.4s; SLA violation prevented

scenarios.name: Database Slow Transaction Contention
scenarios.fault_injected: Injected artificial 2.0s table locks on document metadata table
scenarios.expected_behavior: Identify connection pool bottleneck, shed non-essential reads, protect worker writes
scenarios.observed_behavior: Lock contention identified; pool prioritized worker commits; no connection drops
